purpose: Teach: 情念/一躍/余力/立脚/密教/縛り/着色/周回

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの情念を医療チームで丁寧に汲み取ります
lines.en: Ren, we listen carefully to our patients' emotional needs as a medical team.
lines.style: Steady, clear voice. Measured pace with slight warmth. Opens with gentle directness. Unhurried — the voice of someone who has said this many times and means it each time. No performance, just presence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、一躍注目された治療法も医療チームで検証します
lines.en: Yes — we verify even the suddenly-popular treatments as a team.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. A pause after 'Yes' — brief, thoughtful. Warm but not reassuring: factual. Even pace. The tone of someone explaining how they work, not defending it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救命の余力がある時こそ、貴院、ご対応されますね、先生
lines.en: That's exactly when you do your best work, isn't it — when there's still time to save someone.
lines.style: Soft respect underneath. Slightly hesitant opening — a young person choosing words carefully with an elder. Even pace. Genuine admiration, not flattery. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、根拠に立脚した医療を医療チームで続けます
lines.en: Yes — we continue to practice evidence-based medicine as a team.
lines.style: Calm restatement. Slight emphasis on 'evidence-based' — not defensive, just clear about the principle. Warm but steady. The voice settling into its own conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 密教医療と現代医療の境界を、貴院、研究されてますね、先生
lines.en: You're researching the line between traditional and modern medicine, aren't you — I think that's what makes this hospital different.
lines.style: Wondering, genuine curiosity. Soft opening. Building slightly toward the observation at the end — not accusatory, genuinely asking. Young person thinking aloud with someone wise.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、過度に患者を縛りつける身体拘束を医療チームで避けます
lines.en: Yes — we avoid restraints that bind patients excessively. That's a principle we hold as a team.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Quiet conviction on 'avoid.' Not defensive — stating something that matters. Warm still, but with an undertone of something hard-won in that principle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 検査試料を着色する手法を、貴院、改善されてますね、先生
lines.en: The way you've improved your lab sample preparation — that attention to detail shows in everything you do.
lines.style: Observant, almost offhand. Noticing something true. Warm but not flattering. Slight pause before the second clause — genuine reflection, not rehearsed praise.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、定期検診を周回する地域巡回を医療チームで継続します
lines.en: Yes — we keep running regular check-ups through the surrounding communities. That's ongoing work for our team.
lines.style: Warm closure. Slight softness on 'surrounding communities' — the care extending outward. Steady, resolved. The voice of someone at peace with the long, quiet work of medicine.
